sampling.event_anchor: supplied annotation frame without legacy boundary clamping

inference.tracker: ByteTrack reset within each 16-image context, matching training
inference.common_input: Both fitted arms use the same annotation-free 7.5-Hz presentation grid
inference.invalid_window: No prediction; gap resets persistence; never impute or replace a clip
inference.clock: Actual last sampled frame PTS, normalized to the first source frame

constraints.pre_event_definition: Valid context end PTS strictly less than supplied event PTS minus 1 second
constraints.aggregation: Equal weight per clip with at least one eligible context; unsupported clips are disclosed, not assigned zero exposure
constraints.selection_rule: Maximize training-holdout event recall subject to both constraints; ties minimize off-target episodes then maximize threshold; insufficient support or infeasibility remains unselected

comparison: All eight positive-context constrained policies versus their original onset-only training-selected policies and same-grid constant controls on each new 100-clip cohort
uncertainty: Pointwise paired source-clip bootstrap,2000 resamples,seed42,fixed models/calibration; report all policies and test constraint exceedance
scope: Calibration-motivated follow-up after the previous event study; new continuous-event replays exclude previously replayed sources, but paired-window test scores on these sources were already observed. Pre-event contexts are annotation-derived accident-clip prefixes, not independently reviewed normal CCTV.
default_policy: Retain 500-clip reference binaries and desktop defaults; do not select replacements on test scores
